routes.name: Golden visa (creatives in culture and arts)

note: United Arab Emirates, read on the government's official portal (u.ae): the work visa and the Golden visa pages (the Golden visa's updated 28 July 2026; read 2026-10-30). A foreigner employed in the government or private sector holds the standard employment visa, valid for two years and renewable, which the employer applies for (work for the sponsor). Those with exceptional talent, creatives in culture and arts among them, may have the Golden visa for 10 years, with the Ministry of Culture's recommendation for creatives: a renewable long-term residence visa to live, work or study without needing a sponsor (read as any work). The Green visa for skilled workers, freelancers and the self-employed is on a page not read. Fees (set by the ICP and each emirate's GDRFA), decision times and GCC citizens' right to live and work were not read; the ICP's own site answered with a captcha and was not used. The UAE has no naturalisation by years of residence, so no route counts.
